Here's the full picture.

## 1. Interface / abstraction definition

**`markdown.Service`** — `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:31-55`

```go
type Service interface {
    ExtractAll(content []byte) (*ExtractedData, error)
    ExtractTags(content []byte) ([]string, error)
    ExtractProperties(content []byte) (*storepb.MemoPayload_Property, error)
    RenderMarkdown(content []byte) (string, error)   // AST -> markdown text
    RenderHTML(content []byte) (string, error)       // markdown -> HTML
    GenerateSnippet(content []byte, maxLength int) (string, error)
    ValidateContent(content []byte) error
    RenameTag(content []byte, oldTag, newTag string) (string, error)
}
```
Doc comment (lines 27-30) notes it wraps goldmark for parsing/extraction; HTML rendering server-side is mainly for RSS since the frontend renders markdown itself via `react-markdown`.

## 2. Concrete runtime implementation

**`*markdown.service`** (unexported struct) — `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:58-60`
```go
type service struct {
    md goldmark.Markdown
}
```
Wraps `github.com/yuin/goldmark`. Methods implementing `Service`: `ExtractTags` (143), `ExtractProperties` (193), `RenderMarkdown` (244, delegates to `renderer.MarkdownRenderer` at line 250), `RenderHTML` (255), `GenerateSnippet` (264), `ValidateContent` (349), `ExtractAll` (356), `RenameTag` (425).

There is no mock/fake in the repo (`grep -l mock/Mock/Fake` on files referencing `markdown.Service` returns nothing) — this is the sole implementation used everywhere, including in tests, via the real constructor.

Internally, `RenderMarkdown` uses a second concrete (non-interface) helper type, `*renderer.MarkdownRenderer` — `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/renderer/markdown_renderer.go:15-24` (struct) and `Render` method (line 27) — but this is not itself behind an interface; it's just an AST-to-markdown-text serializer used internally by `service`.

      markdown.WithMentionExtension(),

- `/bench/repo/server/server.go:76` — `apiV1Service := apiv1.NewAPIV1Service(s.Secret, profile, store)` (this is where the `markdown.Service` instance is actually created during server bootstrap).

- `APIV1Service` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`, field `MarkdownService markdown.Service`. Used at:

- `memopayload.Runner` — `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`, field `MarkdownService markdown.Service` (set via `NewRunner`, line 19-24; used internally at line 52). - `RebuildMemoPayload(_ context.Context, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service) error` — `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74` — a free function depending on the abstraction via parameter, not a struct field.

## Frontend (TypeScript) note

On the web side there is **no equivalent interface/abstraction** for markdown processing. `/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoContent/MemoMarkdownRenderer.tsx` renders markdown directly via the third-party `ReactMarkdown` component (from `react-markdown`) configured with remark/rehype plugins — there's no custom `MarkdownRenderer`-style interface with swappable implementations; the component itself is the concrete rendering entry point. `MarkdownRenderContext` (`/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoContent/MarkdownRenderContext.tsx:3`, `interface MarkdownRenderContextValue`) is just a React context value shape (compact mode flags, mention resolution, etc.), not a markdown-processing abstraction. content.text:
h13.

**Interface:** `Service` in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:31-55` — methods for extracting tags/mentions/properties, rendering markdown/HTML, snippet generation, validation, and tag renaming.

- **impl** — the unexported `service` struct (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:58-60`), which wraps a `goldmark.Markdown` instance and implements all `Service` methods (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:143-453`). It's the only production implementation; markdown-to-markdown re-rendering is delegated internally to `renderer.MarkdownRenderer` (`internal/markdown/renderer/markdown_renderer.go:16`), a concrete helper type, not itself an interface implementer.

- **construction** — built exactly once at runtime by `markdown.NewService(markdown.WithTagExtension(), markdown.WithMentionExtension())` inside `NewAPIV1Service` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51`), which configures goldmark with GFM plus the custom tag/mention extensions. (A second `markdown.NewService(...)` call exists only in test scaffolding, `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44`, not runtime.)

- **holders** — the resulting `Service` value is threaded through as the interface type, not the concrete struct:
